definition.question: How intense is US-China trade and tariff confrontation?
definition.low_end: Low tariffs, stable trade flows and routine economic dialogue with few restrictions.
definition.high_end: Prohibitive tariffs, sweeping trade embargoes and near-complete bilateral trade rupture.

readings.rationale: Unassessed - evidence set contains no graded claims on tariff rates, Section 301 actions, trade volumes or financial decoupling to ground a placement. Research needed: current US and Chinese tariff schedules, bilateral trade data, and capital-market/investment restriction actions. Would be higher with new tariff hikes or import bans; lower with tariff rollbacks or trade-deal implementation.

Previously unassessed 2026-10-01 for lack of tariff/trade data. New confirmed evidence shows de-escalation from prohibitive-tariff extreme: Busan Nov 2025 truce (US tariff cuts, Chinese pledges on rare earths/25Mt soybeans/fentanyl) extended to Jan 10 2027 with $30B non-sensitive goods each way for reduced tariffs and likely 10Mt coal imports 2027-28.
